messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, I need to refill my mother's blood pressure pill, the amlodipine. Irene Kowalski.
AGENT: I'd be happy to help you refill your mother's amlodipine. To get started, I need to verify her identity. What's her date of birth?
CALLER: March 3rd, 1942.
AGENT: Great, I've verified Irene's information. Before I pull up her prescriptions, are you Walter, her son?  [system actions: verify_identity]
CALLER: Yeah, that's me, Walt. Now can we get this refill sorted? She's down to three pills.
AGENT: I found her amlodipine, but it has zero refills left. I can send a renewal request to Dr. Thomas Hughes right now. Which Harbor store would you like us to send it to—is H-101 still the best location for her?  [system actions: list_prescriptions]
CALLER: No refills? She's only got three left. Yeah, H-101's fine, just get it moving.
AGENT: Perfect, I've sent the renewal request to Dr. Hughes. Since your mom is running low, a pharmacist can also look into whether a short emergency supply is possible while we wait for the doctor to respond. Would you like me to have a pharmacist give you a call about that?  [system actions: request_renewal]
CALLER: Yeah, sure, have them call. But so what happens if the doctor doesn't answer by then?
AGENT (LATEST): I'll flag a pharmacist to call you right now about the emergency supply option. As for the doctor—we'll follow up with Dr. Hughes's office, and they typically get back to us pretty quickly on renewals like this. If there's any delay, the pharmacist can discuss what options might be available when they call. All set. A pharmacist will call you today to talk through the emergency supply and the renewal status. Is there anything else I can help with?  [system actions: flag_pharmacist_callback]

CONDITIONS:
stop_0: Agent confirms renewal sent to Dr. Hughes and explains the backup.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"stop_0": {"met": true, "why": "Agent confirmed renewal sent and explained pharmacist backup plan."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
